Description: Reporting period covered by the annual payday loan statistics (fiscal year, typically July 1 to June 30).
Allowed Value/Notes: Text pattern like "July 1, YYYY - June 30, YYYY"; one row per annual period.

Description: Number of unique borrowers who were granted more than one payday loan during the period.
Number of repeat payday loans granted during the period (loans issued to borrowers who took more than one loan).
Number of unique borrowers who were granted repeat loans during the period.
Allowed Value/Notes: Non-negative integer; distribution across repeat-frequency columns may sum to this value.

Description: Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 1 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 2 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 3 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 4 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 5 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 6 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing exactly 7 time(s) during the period.
Number of borrowers who repeated borrowing eight or more times during the period.
Allowed Value/Notes: Non-negative integer; grouped upper tail of repeat-frequency distribution.

Description: Total number of payday loans granted during the period (all borrowers).
Average dollar amount of a loan granted during the period.
Allowed Value/Notes: Typically positive; displayed to 2 decimal places.

Column Name: Estimated Total Value of Loans Granted
Description: Estimated total dollar value of all loans granted during the period.
Allowed Value/Notes: Typically equals Total Loans Granted x Average Amount Loan Granted (approx.).

Description: Default rate for loans in the period.
Average dollar amount of loans that defaulted during the period.
